The city of Shechem likely takes its name from the saddle-like 'shoulder' of the ridge between Gerizim and Ebal (Gen 48:22). In prophetic idiom, 'turning the shoulder' becomes a metaphor for stubborn refusal to listen -- an image of someone literally turning their back on the speaker (Neh 9:29; Zech 7:11)."
